subject.title: fix(cli): report a cold-start session as "agent starting", not "needs reconnect"

question: Should the prompt-session stderr banner replace the existing “agent needs reconnect” token with “agent starting” for every unhealthy queue-owner probe?
rationale: The code and live proof support the semantic correction, but AGENTS.md treats output naming as product surface and downstream automation may depend on the existing exact token.

options.title: Adopt “agent starting”
options.body: Accept the clearer transitional token and treat the exact stderr wording change as an intentional compatibility adjustment.

options.title: Choose another stable token
options.body: Request a different maintainer-approved phrase while preserving the PR’s narrow status-only implementation and focused tests.

options.title: Preserve current wording
options.body: Reject the token change to avoid compatibility churn, accepting that normal cold starts continue to look like operator-actionable failures.

recommendation.title: Adopt “agent starting”
recommendation.body: Accept the clearer transitional token and treat the exact stderr wording change as an intentional compatibility adjustment.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest available history signal is the original queue-owner lifecycle implementation that defines what this banner state means.
